description: Get one customer by id: the account summary (identity, status, verification, lock, last login, company, companyRole - the effective company role, a key of the workspace's role catalogue (v1: admin, buyer), buyer unless staff set another for the company they belong to now, null without a company - priceList (the list assigned to the customer themselves, ignored while they belong to a company), effectivePriceList (the list that prices their carts and orders: id, name, source MEMBER or COMPANY, companyName when COMPANY; null = catalogue prices) and orderStats: non-canceled order count, last order date and net spend in minor units per currency, null without orders:view) plus the profile record's data. Read-only.
name: get_customer
title: Get customer
